verdict.rationale: Claude is API-first, so it runs headlessly through the Messages API, the official SDKs, the `ant` CLI for shell scripting, the asynchronous Batches API, and Managed Agents for long-running async work. However, the evidence never documents CI use specifically, so the CI half of the story is only implied. missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g. a CI pipeline or GitHub Actions guide), non-interactive CLI auth and exit-code semantics for CI runs, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The `ant` command-line tool for shell scripting and interactive use.
Each SDK provides idiomatic interfaces, type safety, and built-in support for streaming, retries, and error handling
Process large volumes of Messages requests asynchronously with the Message Batches API
Pre-built, configurable agent harness that runs in managed infrastructure | Long-running tasks and asynchronous work
